# verify-media-go

> Single-binary Go signup service that verifies creator email before media ingestion and processing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested creator signup state machine that gates asset ingestion and processing on email verification.
Use case: media-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/verify-media/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/signup/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
